headline_item.title_zh: 中国国安部强化获取高端芯片的情报攻势
headline_item.title_en: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 中国国家安全部被曝设立专门工作组，旨在突破美国高端AI芯片出口限制，并涉嫌通过商业情报收集手段获取技术核心
headline_item.event_summary_en: China's Ministry of State Security, led by Minister Chen Yixin, has established a specialized task force reporting directly to him to bypass U.S. semiconductor export restrictions. The unit focuses on illicit procurement of restricted high-end Nvidia AI chips and intelligence gathering on key chip executives to counter Western technological blockades.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】中国国家安全部部长陈一新及其直属专项工作组，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在中国与全球半导体供应链环境：设立专项工作组实施“反封锁”战略，包括走私高端芯片与搜集企业高管情报
【起因与机理】落实习近平总书记关于突破未来产业“卡脖子”技术的指示，应对美国出口管制
【核心事实细节】核心动因：响应国家层面关于解决高端半导体“卡脖子”技术难题的最高战略指示。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：强化了美方对中国科技公司的人员背景调查与供应链透明度要求，提升贸易摩擦烈度。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Minister of State Security Chen Yixin and his dedicated task force; Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang: Implementing an anti-blockade strategy involving illicit chip procurement and intelligence operations against tech executives
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address 'chokehold' problems and overcome U.S. export controls as directed by President Xi Jinping
[Key Fact Detail] Core motivation: Response to national-level directives to overcome 'chokehold' technological bottlenecks in high-end semiconductors.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Strategic impact: Intensification of U.S. supply chain vetting and personnel background checks, escalating technological trade friction.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着中国已将芯片获取提升至国家安全情报优先级，预示全球半导体贸易合规审查将向更深层的反间谍与供应链安全审查转化。英伟达等核心厂商未来在华业务的战略空间将被迫收缩，供应链管控将从单纯的贸易禁令演变为涵盖人员背景调查的复杂合规泥潭。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This development signals that chip procurement has shifted to a high-priority national security intelligence mission, forcing a transition from standard trade compliance to complex counter-espionage and supply chain vetting. Key manufacturers like Nvidia will face significant shrinkage in their operational flexibility, as compliance protocols evolve to cover personnel security and deep-tier espionage risks.

headlines.title_zh: 特斯拉推送FSD V15，引入实时AI视频渲染
headlines.title_en: Tesla rolls out FSD v15, featuring a photorealistic rendering of car surroundings; Elon Musk says it is real-time AI video generation without using game engines (Mike Pearl/Gizmodo)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 特斯拉正式向部分车型推送FSD V15系统，核心升级在于抛弃传统游戏引擎，通过实时AI视频生成技术实现车载环境的写实级渲染
headlines.event_summary_en: Tesla has rolled out FSD v15 to select vehicles this Saturday, featuring a visualization system that abandons game engine rendering in favor of real-time AI video generation. This transition represents a shift in Tesla's perception architecture from traditional rule-based rendering to end-to-end generative AI synthesis for real-time environment representation.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】特斯拉（Tesla Inc.），首席执行官埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）在自动驾驶软件部署与视觉感知系统：发布FSD V15版本，引入基于生成式AI的实时视频渲染技术
【起因与机理】旨在通过消除游戏引擎负载优化自动驾驶的决策感知链路
【核心事实细节】FSD V15版本正式上线，核心替换渲染技术栈。
【各方立场与态度】技术革新旨在提升系统感知实时性并降低对底层渲染算力依赖。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Tesla Inc., CEO Elon Musk: Released FSD v15 with generative AI-based real-time video rendering
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To optimize decision-making and perception latency by eliminating reliance on game engines
[Key Fact Detail] FSD v15 launch with a new rendering stack.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic focus on reducing latency and reliance on traditional rendering compute.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 从传统游戏引擎向实时视频生成的跨越，暗示特斯拉正在将大模型能力向车辆端侧边缘计算迁移，以解决感知信息到三维空间建模的延迟损耗。此技术路线的成功将直接重塑高阶智驾对于高精地图的依赖程度，强制竞争对手在算力利用效率和端侧模型架构上进行防御性升级。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The transition from game engine rendering to real-time video synthesis signals a shift toward edge-based large model integration, minimizing the latency between perception and 3D spatial modeling. This advancement significantly diminishes the necessity for high-definition maps and mandates a defensive architectural pivot from competitors focusing on hardware-agnostic, rule-based autonomous driving systems.

headlines.title_zh: 数学界证实勒文·阿尔伯格完成黎曼猜想形式化证明
headlines.title_en: A joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities says "we have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct" (Lean community blog)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 数学家勒文·阿尔伯格通过1700万行Lean代码完成黎曼猜想证明，并获Lean与Mathlib社区官方认证
headlines.event_summary_en: Mathematician Levent Alpöge released a formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis on November 20, 2026, consisting of 17 million lines of Lean code relying on the Mathlib library. The Lean and Mathlib communities have officially certified the proof's correctness after comprehensive verification of its logic and codebase.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】数学家勒文·阿尔伯格；Lean与Mathlib社区；Lean FRO在Lean与Mathlib社区官方博客：完成黎曼猜想的形式化证明，包含1700万行代码，并获得社区技术合规认证
【起因与机理】利用交互式定理证明器消除传统数学证明中的复杂性与人工错误，推动计算数学范式变革
【关键数据与实测】关键细节：包含1700万行Lean代码的黎曼猜想证明，通过了严苛的四项形式化合规审查。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：形式化证明成为数学研究的新标准，将重塑纯数学研究的验证流程。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Levent Alpöge; Lean and Mathlib communities; Lean FRO (Lean and Mathlib community blog): Completed a formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis via 17 million lines of code, certified by the community
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Leveraging interactive theorem provers to eliminate complexity and human error in traditional proofs
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Formal proofs become the new standard, reshaping verification workflows in pure mathematics.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次证明标志着“形式化数学”从学术边缘走向核心，证明了超大规模计算验证复杂猜想的可行性。该事件将极大加速数学定理验证的自动化进程，并为AI辅助科学发现提供了高置信度的底层范式。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This milestone marks the transition of 'formal mathematics' from the academic periphery to the core, validating the feasibility of using massive-scale computation to resolve complex conjectures. It will accelerate the automation of theorem verification and establish a high-confidence paradigm for AI-driven scientific discovery.

titans.quote_zh:
有没有注意到人工智能代理是如何过于字面地遵循你的指令的。

这就是为什么我一直在研究 @FensoryApp 如何处理在我看来真正重要的部分。

这些限制不仅仅是您在聊天中告诉客服人员的事情。

您可以设置每个订单可以交易的最大规模的市场，并且这些规则位于帐户中。

然后，每个订单在达到超流动性之前都会受到检查。

因此，如果限额为 100 美元，代理不能突然决定 101 美元就可以了，哈哈。

对我来说有趣的是，代理仍然有空间做出自己的决定。

它可以选择策略并执行交易，但账户规则不受其控制。

titans.quote_en:
Ever notice how an ai agent can follow your instructions a little too literally.

https://t.co/nzjQQj85UT

That is why i have been looking at how @FensoryApp handles the part that actually matters imo.

The limits are not just something you tell the agent in chat.

You set the markets it can trade the max size for each order and those rules sit on the account.

Then every order gets checked before it reaches hyperliquid.

So if the limit is $100 the agent can not suddenly decide $101 is fine lol.

The interesting part for me is that the agent still gets room to make its own decisions.

It can choose the strategy and execute trades but the account rules stay outside its control.

One thing i did probably add though.

A per order cap does not really tell you how much damage can happen across a whole day.

I did want a daily loss limit too especially if the strategy keeps running while i am not watching.

Because giving an agent permission to trade is one thing.

Deciding exactly how far that permission goes is another.

If you were setting up an agent on @FensoryApp would you care more about a max order size or a daily loss limit?

titans.quote_en:
An autonomous AI agent still depending on someone else's cloud subscription feels like a missing piece.

@Acurast has an interesting approach through its Deploy Agent.

Instead of requiring a developer account or an $ACU balance, an agent can pay for compute using USDC on Base through x402.

The process is fairly straightforward:

➛ Request compute through the Deploy Agent
➛ Pay using USDC
➛ Run the workload on Acurast infrastructure
No traditional cloud signup required.
That's a useful distinction for agents expected to operate independently.

The next question is whether the execution cost and reliability can compete with conventional hosting.
